steps.description: Who delivers a new client once the kickoff is confirmed. Reviewers and the backup manager are set when you activate the agent.

steps.description: The shared team mailbox the agent sends reviewed messages from and reads replies in. Use one mailbox for both so replies can be matched to what was sent. Optional at install: without it the steps that need it are prepared as drafts for a person to send.
steps.title: Connections

steps.description: How quickly the reviewer is chased. Nothing is ever approved by waiting.

fields.helpText: After this many business days without a decision the reviewer is reminded; the backup manager is asked after the next reminder.
fields.label: Remind the reviewer after (business days)
